notices.scope: Technical content inventory only; no legal compliance conclusion. Exact archive names, text heads and resource scans were verified from fully checksum-verified CI artifacts.

native_execution_evidence: Remote Windows CI installation, native UI smoke, isolated payload probe, and uninstall; local machine performed static checks only
notes: Qt/PySide/Shiboken notice files currently contain only four identical 470-byte commercial terms; complete LGPL/GPL texts and Chromium attribution material have not been verified in this c332265 package. Release remains pending notice supplementation.

Eight .pak resource archives were parsed resource by resource including gzip and Brotli. No complete Chromium credits HTML was identified. A devtools debug JavaScript resource contains a short LGPL2 header, which is not the complete license text.

The full Qt6WebEngineCore.dll was searched in ASCII and UTF-16 and its valid gzip/zlib resource candidates were inspected. These checks did not identify full Chromium credits; arbitrary native binary searches cannot prove all possible compiled encodings absent.
README, custom LICENSE, and backend_runner are exact source content after Windows checkout CRLF conversion; raw byte hashes differ and are explicitly recorded.
